sourceNotes.rawContent: This innovative gold-finished copper ring features a unique, openable heart or round locket design. Lightweight and adjustable, it allows you to customize your style with replaceable accessories. Comfortable for daily wear, it's the perfect sentimental gift for any modern jewelry collection.
